question.text: If the equations <math> <mrow> <msup> <mi>x</mi> <mn>2</mn> </msup> <mo>+</mo> <mn>2</mn> <mi>x</mi> <mo>+</mo> <mn>3</mn> <mo>=</mo> <mn>0</mn> </mrow> </math> and <math> <mi>a</mi><msup> <mi>x</mi> <mn>2</mn> </msup> <mo>+</mo><mi>b</mi><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>c</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn><mo>,</mo></math> <math> <mrow> <mi>a</mi><mo>,</mo><mi>b</mi><mo>,</mo><mi>c</mi><mo>∈</mo><mi>R</mi><mo>,</mo> </mrow> </math> have a common root, then <math> <mrow> <mi>a</mi><mo>:</mo><mi>b</mi><mo>:</mo><mi>c</mi> </mrow> </math> is:

solution.text:
As the roots of x 2 + 2 x + 3 = 0  are imaginary, hence both the roots are common with a x 2 +bx+c=0 .

∴a1=b2=c3.
